findings.text: display.saddle_offset_mm is asserted only finite; the independent saddle-offset check the brief names was added in 122de5110 and deleted in f9debe44f, so one of the three self-referential assertions the node was chartered to replace now has no value check at all and a regression at nova/equilibrium/display_flux.py:395 passes the whole gate.

test_a_stored_panel_polishes_its_own_saddle fits the archive's own spline and never constructs a display map or reads a renderer field, so no display_flux regression can redden it, and the 0.2 bound at line 159 is stated with no justification for its size.

the promoted-count check compares the committed receipt's promoted_node_count with the committed archive's mask prefix, and both artefacts are the renderer's own output, so a renderer regression reddens it only once the receipt is regenerated.

the fragment records one red control and the brief asks for one per new check; the declared mutation leaves the new lattice-length acceptance assertion at tests/test_display_flux.py:398 passing (negative-control.log fails at the raises assertion), and the two stored-panel checks have no recorded red at all.

baseline_suite.command carries an angle-bracket scratch-tree placeholder the record contract refuses, and measurement_module at manifest.md:17 names profile_map_cost.py rather than the module under test the scratch-tree base arm imported; both are recoverable from base-gate.log:3.
